capabilities: Load TeX macro definitions from a vault file
Apply macros to MathJax math in notes
Report definition errors with line numbers
disambiguation: Not a LaTeX document compiler; it only loads TeX macro definitions into Obsidian's MathJax math renderer.
extras: Pro features require a GitHub Sponsors payment; removed macro definitions remain active until Obsidian restarts, and reload only redraws Reading views.
intentEvidence: loads TeX commands from one file in your vault into the math engine of Obsidian
problem: Obsidian math notes cannot share custom TeX macros without repeating definitions in each note.
summary: Loads a LaTeX preamble from one vault file and makes its TeX commands available in MathJax math across notes.
